dialogues.speaker: Unknown Person's Etchings
dialogues.text: "...Knock, Abbas. Knock harder. If you knock the right place, you can break these mud walls. Then, you will never have to eat grass or lizards again."

dialogues.speaker: Unknown Person's Etchings
dialogues.text: "Knock, Abbas. Don't be afraid. You can get out. Don't be afraid. You can get out. Don't be afraid. You can get out..."
